title: La cible, c'est la femme chez le coiffeur  (The Target Is the Woman at the Hairdresser's)

segments.t: At the agency, Noémie and Mathias discuss a plan involving the soap opera's loyal viewers and a proposed notice. Camille listens from the doorway. Mathias thinks the idea goes too far. Listen to the French first and follow how a suggestion is offered, rejected and replaced with another task.
Notre public, c'est la femme qui parle chez le coiffeur.
Le genre de femme qui adore Jonathan Joubert.
Ryan, je veux dire.
Il nous faut une rumeur pour faire réagir les fans.
C'est quoi votre idée, comme un avis de décès?
Exactement!
Je me suis inspirée de cette affaire d'un enfant disparu en Corrèze.
C'est horrible.
Écoutez, laissez tomber.
Occupez-vous d'Audrey Fleurot.
Elle a un problème d'emploi du temps avec ses enfants.
Merci quand même.
De rien.
Camille begins with the audience she thinks would care most about Ryan.
Notre public, c'est la femme qui parle chez le coiffeur.

'Our audience is the woman chatting at the hairdresser's.' The word for at can introduce a person or their place of work. At the hairdresser's means in the salon, rather than simply beside a hairdresser.
Le genre de femme qui adore Jonathan Joubert.
'The kind of woman who adores Jonathan Joubert.' Kind is followed by of before the person described. The next word means who and makes that woman the subject of adores.
Ryan, je veux dire.
'Ryan, I mean.' The expression literally says I want to say. In conversation it corrects a word or name the speaker has just used.
Il nous faut une rumeur pour faire réagir les fans.
'We need a rumor to make the fans react.' The impersonal expression says that something is necessary to us. The little word for us identifies who needs the rumour, rather than who spreads it.
C'est quoi votre idée, comme un avis de décès?

'What is your idea, like a death notice?' The question word comes after the identifying expression in this casual question. A death notice is a public announcement, which is why it sounds so extreme here.
Exactement!
'Exactly!' The single word confirms that the suggestion matches her idea exactly. It can answer a whole question without repeating its wording.
Je me suis inspirée de cette affaire d'un enfant disparu en Corrèze.

'I took inspiration from that case of a missing child in Corrèze.' The past action of taking inspiration uses be as its helper because it is reflexive. The missing child is described with a completed form of disappear.
C'est horrible.
'It's horrible.' The description has the same spelling for masculine and feminine things. Here the simple judgment rejects the whole idea, rather than describing one person.
Écoutez, laissez tomber.
'Listen, drop it.' The polite instruction literally says let fall. The expression means to stop pursuing the idea, without dropping a physical object.
Occupez-vous d'Audrey Fleurot.
'Take care of Audrey Fleurot.' The word for yourself attaches after the polite instruction. Take care of introduces the person whose problem Noémie should now handle.
Elle a un problème d'emploi du temps avec ses enfants.
'She has a schedule problem with her children.' The expression for schedule literally means use of time. With introduces the children whose needs are making her timetable difficult.
Merci quand même.
'Thanks all the same.' The final two words mean all the same. They acknowledge the effort even though the proposed idea has been rejected.
De rien.

'You're welcome.' The reply to thanks literally says of nothing. Its short form keeps the office exchange polite after the awkward proposal. Now listen to the entire office exchange one more time at natural speed.
Notre public, c'est la femme qui parle chez le coiffeur.
Le genre de femme qui adore Jonathan Joubert.
Ryan, je veux dire.
Il nous faut une rumeur pour faire réagir les fans.
C'est quoi votre idée, comme un avis de décès?
Exactement!
Je me suis inspirée de cette affaire d'un enfant disparu en Corrèze.
C'est horrible.
Écoutez, laissez tomber.
Occupez-vous d'Audrey Fleurot.
Elle a un problème d'emploi du temps avec ses enfants.
Merci quand même.
De rien.
Mathias rejects the notice and gives Noémie another job. Camille has heard the conversation about the viewers. Listen again for I mean, drop it and thanks all the same. See you next time.
Bonne journée!
